messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Amoxicillin can make birth control pills less effective. Ask your doctor about using a non-hormone method of birth control (such as a condom, diaphragm, or spermicide) to prevent pregnancy while taking this medicine. Take this medication for the full prescribed length of time. Your symptoms may improve before the infection is completely cleared. Amoxicillin will not treat a viral infection such as the common cold or flu. Do not share this medication with another person, even if they have the same symptoms you have.
Antibiotic medicines can cause diarrhea. This may happen while you are taking amoxicillin, or within a few months after you stop taking it. This may be a sign of a new infection. If you have diarrhea that is watery or bloody, stop taking this medicine and call your doctor. Do not use anti-diarrhea medicine unless your doctor tells you to.
Triplet: ["amoxicillin", "does not treat", "flu"]

The relation 'does not treat' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject medication is ineffective against the condition or illness specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'not used to treat': The subject drug is inappropriate or contraindicated for the treatment of the condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'contraindicated in': The subject drug should not be used by patients who have the condition or characteristic specified by the object entity.
C. 'has effectiveness condition': The subject drug is only as effective as specified in the object entity when the condition is met.
D. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
E. 'not approved for': The subject drug is not approved or not recommended for use in the patient population specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
